author: diassishe
quote: All this рathetic fantasy роrn about a tall, blond, jacked, Swedish-model-looking guy simping for mexican tortas could've been somewhat forgiven if the rest of the game were actually enjoyable. Can't steal cool cars, can't shoot up crowded places, the explosion animations are laughable, the unnecessary slow-mo every time your car hits something is grating. For a game with this much nonstop talking, the dialogue is insufferable. No wit, no personality, no humor. It's like some low-iq middle schooler wrote the whole thing. I couldn't bring myself to care about any of the characters, main or otherwise. They could all die in the next scene and I wouldn't bat an eye. Wasn't a surprice finding out that there was a political purge at rockstar that got and all the cool people and veteran animators under the knife. Which makes current Rockstar a corpse skinwalked by whatever crawled inside it over the past decade. Once free and edgy franchise has finally gotten too big for political busybodies to ignore. Many such cases.
